bio: Tucked away in a quiet city centre mews, this smart restaurant is the brainchild of an experienced chef and wine importer. This background shines through in an impressive wine list with over 1,500 choices, including a brilliant selection of burgundies and grower champagnes, plus plenty of biodynamic and organic options. The cooking is pared-back and vibrant, utilising ingredients from their own farm and local producers. The friendly team enhance the experience and the lunch menu is a steal....
